name: segment-into-4
description: Cut the current part into 4 radial wedges with dovetail joints, then lay the pieces out in Blender the way they will sit on the print plate.

script_path.description: Part script to cut. Leave blank to use the script the PartForge panel is pointed at.

wedges.description: How many equal wedges to cut the part into, around the Z axis

joint_type.description: How the pieces hold together: dovetail, pin, magnet or none

joint_tolerance.description: Deliberate gap between mating faces. Bigger = looser fit

collection.description: Blender collection the pieces are loaded into

steps.label: Lay the pieces out on the plate
